subject.title: [Feature]: Skill author-defined setup hook (run skill-supplied script on install/update)

question: Should OpenClaw support skill-authored setup script execution as a core install/update lifecycle hook, or should this remain an explicit external plugin/admin workflow?
rationale: The request crosses a host execution and credential-environment boundary, and source evidence shows the missing behavior is real but not safely automatable without maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Approve opt-in core hook
options.body: Add `metadata.openclaw.setup.script` plus default-off install/update execution gated by explicit admin opt-in, realpath confinement, host-owned timeout, minimal env, and redacted diagnostics.

options.title: Route through plugin and SDK
options.body: Keep core install/update behavior unchanged and make the published `@alexminza/skills-setup` style path canonical after stable installed-skill SDK helpers land.

options.title: Reject host setup execution
options.body: Leave setup to wrapper scripts or out-of-band operator flows because third-party install-time command execution is not an accepted OpenClaw trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in core hook
recommendation.body: Add `metadata.openclaw.setup.script` plus default-off install/update execution gated by explicit admin opt-in, realpath confinement, host-owned timeout, minimal env, and redacted diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core product/API boundary decision spanning skill metadata, Plugin SDK shape, and security expectations.
